title: hedyotis benguetensis
intro: Hedyotis benguetensis, commonly known as Benguet hedge or Benguet button, is a plant species in the family Rubiaceae. It is a traditional medicinal plant used in Filipino folk medicine to treat various health conditions. The plant is known to have health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which may help in the treatment of fever, cough, and respiratory infections. The bioactive constituents of Hedyotis benguetensis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which may exhibit therapeutic actions such as modulating the immune system, reducing oxidative stress, and inhibiting the growth of microorganisms.
